name: Deform360
summary: 多视角与双手触觉操作数据，用于预测可变形物体动态。
summaryEn: Multiview and bimanual tactile interaction data for predicting deformable-object dynamics.
scaleZh: 198 个物体；1,980 段交互；215.7 累计多视角小时
access: Official documentation provides data access instructions; download not tested
accessZh: 官方文档提供数据访问说明；未实测下载
license: Consult publisher terms; data license not independently verified
licenseZh: 请核对发布方条款；数据许可尚未独立核实
wmNote: 小时数按多视角累计，不代表等长的独立物理交互；几何追踪有重建误差。
wmNoteEn: Hours accumulate across views, not independent interaction duration; geometry tracking has reconstruction error.

evidence.locator: Download Data; Load Aligned Data; Data Conventions
evidence.statement: The official release pairs timestamp files with camera/tactile streams and documents synchronized observation loading, manipulation data and reconstructed particle dynamics. Its world-model tasks predict subsequent object deformation under interactions.
